1879064141.name: Telling Mark
1879064141.desc: Mark an enemy so that allies can do increased damage to it.\n\nYou may only mark one target at a time.

1879064397.name: Stance: Precision
1879064397.desc:
When active, generates Focus every 5 seconds. 

Quick Shot has increased Critical Chance. 
 
 Upon activation, grants a finesse buff for a short duration.

1879073741.name: Entangling Web
1879073741.desc:
You can cover your target's arms with sticky webbing, slowing their attacks.<rgb=#00ff00>
 
 Applies Ensnared Effect. 
 Stacks 3 times. 
 </rgb>

1879089741.name: 1H Weapon Attack
1879089741.desc: Auto-attack when wielding only a single one-handed weapon.

1879104845.name: Fell Sacrifice
1879104845.desc: Returns target ally to activity from defeat.  Only useable out of combat.

1879110989.name: Friend of the Wilds (Bog-guardian)
1879110989.desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879111501.name: Sticky Gourd
1879111501.desc: Smashes the foe with burning pitch, dealing fire damage.

1879136205.name: Aura of Protection
1879136205.desc: When the fight has begun, your aura strengthens your allies' defences against attacks.

1879136973.name: Lacerate
1879136973.desc: A quick slashing attack, drawing blood from the enemy.

1879138637.name: Curse of the Melancholic Heart
1879138637.desc: A gourd thrown at the target plagues them with spores, weakening their ability to raise morale. This skill is only effective against players.

1879160013.name: Yule Festival Horse
1879160013.desc: A horse from the Yule Festival.

1879197901.name: Friend of Noble Birds (Lesser Giant Eagle)
1879197901.desc: Summons an eagle companion.\n\nThe eagle is a noble creature which can deal damage and, if called upon, will sacrifice itself to save you.

1879213901.name: Sudden Death (Tactical)
1879213901.desc: Your fellowship attempts to strike Draigoch with a final blow.

1879232717.name: Scribe a New Ending
1879232717.desc: Removes Wound, Fear, Poison, and Disease effects from your target.

1879233357.name: Precise Throw
1879233357.desc: A quick attack which deals Light Damage over time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879242317.name: Sign of Power: Inspiration
1879242317.desc: The Lore-master marks an enemy and allows his allies and their mounts to draw inspiration from fighting the marked foe.

1879244877.name: Skill of the Eorlingas
1879244877.desc: The ultimate expression of tactical horsemanship, this is a dangerous strike on its own; when enhanced by the Riddermark Discipline your ranged damage is increased.

1879255501.name: Serrated Edge
1879255501.desc: The initial impact of your weapon is meant to injure your foe, but the true damage is unleashed as you drag your weapon across your foe's flesh.

1879272269.name: Fulgurite Rune-stone
1879272269.desc: Places a Rune-stone upon the ground which, after a few seconds, is struck by lightning, damaging and briefly stunning nearby foes.

1879272909.name: Smashing Strike
1879272909.desc: After using Shield-swipe or Retaliation, smash the enemy with your weapon's blunt pommel or haft.\nIf after Shield-swipe: damage and stun.\nIf after Retaliation: damage and bleed.

1879277005.name: Exit the Haunted Burrow
1879277005.desc: This enables you to quickly return to the entrance of the Haunted Burrow.

1879301197.name: Wintertide Steed
1879301197.desc: A horse from the Yule Festival.

1879302605.name: Call to Arms: Archer (Defender)
1879302605.desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879305549.name: Flaming Upshot
1879305549.desc: This attack does additional fire damage for each point of Focus consumed.

1879316045.name: Slash
1879316045.desc: Slash a single target and generate Wrath. Has a chance to place a healing buff on your fellowship.

1879331533.name: Windfells Goat
1879331533.desc: A goat from the Anniversary Festival.

1879352141.name: Steed of the Alliance of the Third Age
1879352141.desc: A steed representing the combined forces who faced Sauron towards the end of the Third Age.

1879368653.name: Green Peahen
1879368653.desc: Brings out a green peahen to keep you company.

1879374541.name: Muster in Skarháld
1879374541.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Skarháld.

1879378509.name: Yule Rabbit
1879378509.desc: Brings out a Yule rabbit to keep you company.

1879396941.name: Husky Wolf-dog
1879396941.desc: Brings out a friendly wolf-dog to keep you company.

1879411789.name: Brash Invitation
1879411789.desc: Devotees of the Brawler's art are known for their seeming arrogance and flippancy during battle, often using this to drive their opponents into a careless rage.\n\nSingle-target ranged taunt

1879447373.name: Brick Corgi
1879447373.desc: Brings out a friendly corgi to keep you company.

1879449293.name: Anthem of the Free Peoples
1879449293.desc: Anthem: Increases Incoming Healing and Outgoing Damage of all nearby fellowship or raid members.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 3 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>

1879452365.name: Friendly Heron
1879452365.desc: Summons a beautiful heron to accompany you on your journeys.

1879461709.name: Muster at Clegur
1879461709.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Clegur in Swanfleet.

1879467341.name: Cut-over
1879467341.desc:
Make an aggressive cut, striking multiple foes.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay:</rgb><rgb=#FF0000>
 Flèche applies latent damage.</rgb>

1879492173.name: War-forged Uruk
1879492173.desc: You were built for one purpose: War.\n

1879494093.name: Guise of Karazgar
1879494093.desc: A finely-crafted costume in the guise of the Weeping Warrior, Karazgar. What's beneath his mask? Why, you, of course!

1879506637.name: Umbral Spout
1879506637.desc: Target the earth and summon forth an umbral fumarole that chokes nearby foes with a cloud of shadows reducing tactical damage output and incoming healing.

1879508557.name: Cobalt Grodbog Protector
1879508557.desc: Summons a fierce cobalt grodbog protector to accompany you on your travels.

1879521357.name: Mottled Vulture
1879521357.desc: Summons a mottled vulture to accompany you on your travels.

1879528269.name: Prepared: Frost Breath
1879528269.desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, expel the chilling gelid wind from your lungs, dealing damage in a cone before you.

1879528781.name: Prepared: Frost-spike
1879528781.desc: Send a spike of ice at your target. In so doing, you are covered in an icy shell.

1879529165.name: Test Box
1879529165.desc: This is a frontal box skill with limited targets.
